findings: Pinned header declares version0.8.3. Header version macros and dynamically linked XXH_versionNumber are distinct sources of version truth; no claim about current upstream release.
XXH_NO_STREAM excludes streaming state APIs; XXH_NO_LONG_LONG removes64-bit families and XXH_NO_XXH3 controls newer family. Compile configuration determines API availability.

XXH32/64 reset/update/digest require nonnull state; copyState additionally forbids overlap. Allocation may returnNULL. Digest is documented nonmutating and repeatable before further updates. Caller wrappers must uphold these contracts.

XXH3 secret size minimum136 bytes. Reset-with-secret references external memory that must outlive entire streaming session; one-shot secret also must be sufficiently large/readable. Secret quality affects dispersion, but this remains noncryptographic hashing.

XXH3 selects SIMD according to compile-time predefined macros; x86 runtime dispatcher is a separately named source file. Presence of scalar implementation does not prove automatic runtime fallback in this header.
XXH128_hash_t stores low64 then high64 fields in native endianness; canonical representation remains separate. Equality/comparator helpers compare hash values, not original file bytes.

Documentation for XXH3_128bits_withSeed incorrectly references64-bit unseeded function in seed0 equivalence note, while unseeded128 documentation states128-bit equivalence. Treat as documentation inconsistency; verify actual implementation before any behavior claim.
